name: ine_operations
description: Discover official INE statistical operations by name. Use returned operation IDs; do not guess table IDs or series codes.

name: ine_tables
description: List tables for an INE operation, optionally filtering titles. Retrieves catalog metadata, not observations.

name: ine_table_series
description: Discover series codes in one INE table page. Native provider pagination begins at page 1; output may be filtered locally.

name: ine_series
description: Retrieve INE series observations with metadata, source dates and an age warning. 'Latest in this series' does not imply the current statistical base.

name: ine_series_change
description: Compare the last two non-confidential numerical observations in an INE series, without inventing frequency or annualised growth.
